inputs.text:
"lighting_setup": 
    "type": "Commercial Food Photography Lighting",
    "sources": [
      
        "type": "Key Light",
        "effect": "Creates specular highlights on the bun and tomatoes",
        "position": "Top-left softbox"
      ,
      
        "type": "Fill Light",
        "effect": "Illuminates the textures of the meat and lettuce shadows",
        "position": "Front-right reflector"
      ,
      
        "type": "Rim Light",
        "effect": "Separates edges from the white background, enhancing dimensionality",
        "position": "Back"
      
    ],
    "highlights": "Glistening moisture on vegetables and oil sheen on the patty"
  ,
  "technical_specs": 
    "focus": "Deep depth of field ensuring all layers are sharp (f/16 equivalent)",
    "resolution": "4K Ultra HD",
    "aspect_ratio": "3:4 (Vertical Portrait)",
    "render_style": "Hyper-realistic CGI or composite photography",
    "color_grading": "High vibrance, slightly warm tone for appetite appeal, clean white balance"
  ,
  "scene_description": 
    "type": "Exploded View Product Photography",
    "subject": "Deconstructed Gourmet Hamburger",
    "background": 
      "type": "Pure White Studio Backdrop",
      "color": "#FFFFFF",
      "shadows": "Soft, diffuse drop shadow beneath the bottom bun to ground the image"
    ,
    "composition": 
      "style": "Vertical Levitation Stacking",
      "spacing": "Even vertical distribution allowing visibility of texture on top and bottom surfaces of ingredients",
      "alignment": "Center-aligned ingredients",
      "perspective": "Slightly elevated front angle (approx 15 degrees) to show depth of layers"
    
  ,
  "layers_top_to_bottom": [
    
      "item": "Sesame Bun Crown",
      "annotation": 
        "text": "SESAME BUN CROWN",
        "position": "Left",
        "connector": "Straight black line pointing to the crust"
      ,
      "visual_details": 
        "shape": "Hemispherical dome",
        "surface": "Scattered white sesame seeds, evenly distributed",
        "texture": "Baked dough with a golden-brown gradient crust",
        "interior_face": "Visible porous crumb structure where sliced",
        "lighting_interaction": "Soft gloss on the curvature"
      
    ,
    
      "item": "Fresh Lettuce",
      "annotation": 
        "text": "FRESH LETTUCE",
        "position": "Left",
        "connector": "Straight black line pointing to the leaf edge"
      ,
      "visual_details": 
        "form": "Ruffled, wavy edges, organic and voluminous",
        "type": "Green Leaf or Batavian",
        "color": "Vibrant light to medium green",
        "details": "Small water droplets (condensation) clinging to the leaves to imply freshness",
        "texture": "Crisp, with visible venation"
      
    ,
    
      "item": "Ripe Tomato",
      "annotation": 
        "text": "RIPE TOMATO",
        "position": "Left",
        "connector": "Straight black line pointing to the top slice"
      ,
      "visual_details": 
        "skin": "Smooth, taut red skin on the outer edge",
        "color": "Rich ruby red",
        "surface": "Wet, reflective cut surface showing juice",
        "quantity": "Two distinct slices",
        "structure": "Visible internal chambers, seeds, and gelatinous pulp"
      
    ,
    
      "item": "Melted Cheese",
      "annotation": 
        "text": "MELTED CHEESE",
        "position": "Left",
        "connector": "Straight black line pointing to the drooping corner"
      ,
      "visual_details": 
        "type": "American Cheddar Slice",
        "color": "Saturated yellow-orange",
        "state": "Semi-solid/melting",
        "physics": "Corners drooping downwards due to gravity and simulated heat",
        "texture": "Smooth, waxy sheen, plastic deformation over the patty below"
      
    ,
    
      "item": "Grilled Beef Patty",
      "annotation": 
        "text": "GRILLED BEEF PATTY",
        "position": "Left",
        "connector": "Straight black line pointing to the side of the patty"
      ,
      "visual_details": 
        "color": "Deep brown with darker char marks",
        "shape": "Thick, irregular disc",
        "details": "Distinct parallel grill marks, glistening surface oil/juice, visible texture variation",
        "texture": "Coarse ground beef, caramelized exterior",
        "thickness": "Substantial, representing a 1/4lb or 1/3lb patty"
      
    ,
    
      "item": "Onions & Pickles Layer",
      "annotation": 
        "text": "ONIONS & PICKLES",
        "position": "Left",
        "connector": "Straight black line pointing to a red onion ring"
      ,
      "components": [
        
          "form": "Two concentric rings",
          "name": "Red Onion",
          "color": "Purple skin with white/translucent interior layers"
        ,
        
          "form": "Crinkle-cut chips",
          "name": "Pickles",
          "color": "Pickle green with lighter seed areas",
          "texture": "Wet, bumpy surface"
        
      ],
      "arrangement": "Interleaved, floating just below the patty"
    ,
    
      "item": "Bun Base",
      "annotation": 
        "text": "BUN BASE",
        "position": "Left",
        "connector": "Straight black line pointing to the side crust"
      ,
      "visual_details": 
        "color": "Consistent gradient matching the top bun",
        "shape": "Flat-bottomed disc",
        "surface": "Micro-texture of bread pores",
        "texture": "Golden brown side crust, soft interior face"
      
    
  ],
  "typography_and_graphics": 
    "lines": 
      "style": "Solid thin black lines",
      "endpoints": "Small circular dot on the text side (optional), direct termination on the object side",
      "orientation": "Horizontal lines connecting text to ingredients"
    ,
    "layout": 
      "margin": "Text column positioned on the left third of the canvas",
      "spacing": "Vertical rhythm matches the ingredient spacing"
    ,
    "font_style": 
      "color": "#000000",
      "casing": "UPPERCASE",
      "family": "Sans-serif (e.g., Helvetica or Arial)",
      "weight": "Regular/Medium",
      "alignment": "Left-aligned text blocks"
